description: This file defines an abstract class ContentFile that models a content file with properties such as fileName and mimeType, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ContentFile
classes.description: An abstract class representing a content file with attributes for filename and MIME type.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the content file.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the content file.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the content file.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the content file.
